title: Pick Block Lock
description: Assign hotbar slots for the pick block function to prioritize
body: # Pick Block Lock ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Fabric%2fQuilt%2fNeoForge-silver?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Versions-1.21.11_|_26.1_|_26.2-silver?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Environments-Client_+_Server-silver?style=for-the-badge) ### Assign hotbar slots for the pick block function to prioritize! - Lock specific hotbar slots for Pick Block priority - Manage locked slots with an in-game hotbar screen (`B` by default) - Prioritizes locked slots when picking blocks - Saves your slot choices automatically via a config - Rotates through locked slots when the hotbar is full #### For any issues or feature requests, please make a report on [GitHub](https://github.com/CoolAid48/Pick-Block-Lock/issues) [](https://ko-fi.com/coolaid48) [](https://discord.gg/J2SGshKNah) [](https://www.twitch.tv/coolaid48) ### Will I backport this mod? Probably not, but maybe. If it's requested then I'm more likely to get around to it. ### That being said, does it work on dedicated servers? **Pick Block Lock** is supported on multiplayer, and must be installed on both the client and server for the mod to function.
